calibration.realized_failure_mode: EV tiny-positive but PnL negative with two EV/PnL-regressing windows
calibration.surprise_note: The sample was adequate at 34 selected event trades, but the edge was regime-specific: late_strong won while the two weaker windows more than offset it.

data_source.pit_status: uses accepted_at/usable_trade_date from broad Form 4 archive; no filing-date lookahead added

decision_rationale: The owner-conviction discriminator had a positive partial read but failed the stability/sample gates, so it should not be promoted or retuned on this sample.

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260503-053: Owner-role discriminator rejected on old narrow sample; it said any retry needed materially broader data.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260603-010: Aggregate ownership-delta purchase signal rejected on old narrow PIT queue.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260605-001: Purchase liquidity-intensity old-sample signal was positive but rejected; this run does not retune liquidity.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260614-018: Broad clustered Form 4 open-market buys rejected; reflection allowed a different insider-quality discriminator such as buy size vs owner holdings.
historical_experiment_check.why_not_repeat: Uses the broad 3,901-row archive plus a predeclared owner-conviction ratio, not cluster counts, owner-role labels, liquidity floors, or hold/notional tuning.

hypothesis: Broad PIT Form 4 open-market purchases where the bought shares are at least 10% of the reporting owner's post-transaction holdings may isolate higher conviction insider demand than broad clustered buying, improving candidate-pool event-sleeve EV without adding noisy tickers.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm: LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited; this tests a deterministic free SEC Form 4 data edge.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_action: Do not sweep owner-conviction thresholds on the same archive; new evidence would need a different quality dimension or forward paper outcomes.

parameters.selection_order: entry_date asc, owner_conviction_ratio desc, total_purchase_value desc, ticker asc

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not sweep the 10% owner-conviction floor, the $100k value floor, 10b5-1 handling, event capacity, notional, or hold days on the same broad archive.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs a different evidence source, such as forward paper outcomes for this exact rule or an orthogonal quality signal like verified CEO/CFO non-plan buys paired with fundamental confirmation from a shared default-off helper.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Owner-conviction ratio selected commitment but not stable favorable drift: late_strong benefited, while mid_weak and old_thin both lost event PnL and regressed EV. The likely mechanism is that a large buy relative to a small post-transaction holding can identify insiders adding risk after weakness or in structurally stressed issuers, so the ratio is not a standalone quality edge.

production_impact.production_consistency_read: No live/default production surface changed. A positive replay result is only a lead until the exact rule is moved to a shared default-off helper used by both historical replay and daily paper snapshots.
